name: context-decision
description: Decision continuity with rationale, rejected alternatives, conflict checks, and superseded history.

interface.shortDescription: Remember what was decided, why, and what not to follow.
interface.longDescription: Preserves an accepted decision, its rationale, and rejected alternatives as one authoritative record; recalls the current choice and marks superseded history do_not_follow. Its explicit init skill validates context-core and bootstraps an absent compatible repository in the same call.
defaultPrompt: Before any repository operation, require the exact installed and enabled context-core@jeis-ai-plugins source, context-common/v1 protocol, and a compatible doctor receipt.

For an explicitly invoked $context-decision:init only, accept doctor repository_state=ready or absent; when absent, delegate the fixed core and decision seeds to the active installed context-core public bootstrap surface so the same call reaches decision ready.
Use $context-decision:decision only for an explicit accepted choice with scope and commitment; keep the decision, rationale, and rejected alternatives together.

Never install, enable, or update plugins, probe plugin caches, embed context-core, or install agent policy automatically; all physical repository writes belong to the context-core coordinator and non-init durable mutations retain exact digest approval.
